security: Keep pinned default defense-in-depth enabled; no security-disable workaround.

base-node-memory.filesystem: Fresh public InMemoryFs or Bash files map; setup /fixture/tmp explicitly. Do not mount host paths.
base-node-memory.commands: Omit commands filter so the target and real public dependencies are not accidentally disabled.
base-node-memory.exec: Single Bash.exec per stateful plan; explicit env with replaceEnv:true, rawScript:true, stdinKind:bytes and Latin-1 byte-string encoding only for byte stdin.
base-node-memory.output: Capture public stdoutAsBytes and latin1FromBytes for stdout, UTF-8 stderr text separately; don't treat text API corruption as internal pipe/file corruption.

sqlite-node-local.merge: Merge nested executionLimits, retaining base byte/command bounds.

javascript-node-local.merge: Merge nested executionLimits; no tool hook needed for planned local VFS case.
javascript-node-local.memory: Pinned JS worker sets a 64 MiB QuickJS memory limit. Host worker RSS is different and must be observed separately.
javascript-node-local.nodeAlias: Diagnostic-only nodeStubCommand, not a Node interpreter.

python-node-local.merge: Merge nested executionLimits; no undocumented runtime URL override.
python-node-local.network: None required by inspected vendored loader; no CDN download authorized.

optional-shared-network-not-in-54.port: PORT is a future executor-controlled ephemeral numeric port; this is a template, not a constructor call.
optional-shared-network-not-in-54.alternative: BashOptions.fetch is a SecureFetch host capability. Return FetchResult with Uint8Array body; own strict policy rather than assuming network is applied around it.
optional-shared-network-not-in-54.ours: Shell.use(networkCommands({authorize,transport?})); authorize exact controlled origin/path/method and use supplied signal. Existing public Node transport requires no dependency.
optional-shared-network-not-in-54.effects: Only synthetic local data later; no external requests, writes or user data.

ours-base.entrypoint: src/index.ts via existing tsx loader; distinguish from bundled baseline for any future timing
ours-base.signal: Per-exec AbortSignal.timeout(5000), or 15000 for explicit optional-runtime profile

ours-safejs.reason: No package under allowed local node_modules roots; no actual runtime injected. Private checkout discovery/installation/vendor/adapters are outside scope.
ours-safejs.withoutRuntime: Plugin can register but execution returns 127; do not score this as a configured SafeJS engine failure.
ours-safejs.nameCompatibility: safejs is not js-exec, node, python or python3; no alias substitution allowed.

commonBoundaries: No product or corpus execution authorized by this file.
Presence of assets/modules does not prove worker startup.
A setup-unavailable outcome remains unmeasured, not a baseline loss or ours win.
No install/update/build, native product fallback or private package loading.
Runtime timeout/output/worker limits must be recorded as exact settings and kept separate from native launcher budgets.
